inputs.meaning: Piecewise-constant contact reduction in [0,1], with explicit times and finite horizon.

parameters.name: control_cost
parameters.meaning: Aggregate currency per day multiplying squared control.

parameters.name: terminal_cost
parameters.meaning: Currency per infected person at the declared horizon.

parameters.name: max_step
parameters.meaning: Maximum step in days used in refinement.

outputs.name: new_infections
outputs.meaning: Cumulative flow over the finite horizon, not cases after the horizon.

outputs.name: total_loss
outputs.meaning: Infection loss plus integrated contact-control cost and terminal loss.

outputs.name: infection_flow_residual
outputs.meaning: Cumulative infections less initial susceptible minus current susceptible.

inputs.name: arrival_rate
inputs.meaning: Stationary arrival rate, nonnegative.

inputs.name: service_rate
inputs.meaning: Stationary service rate, strictly above arrival rate.

outputs.name: utilization
outputs.meaning: Arrival rate divided by service rate.

parameters.name: m
parameters.meaning: Nonnegative private marginal benefit of y.

parameters.name: rho
parameters.meaning: Cost interaction with absolute value strictly below one.

outputs.name: principal_payoff
outputs.meaning: Principal payoff after salary and quantity payment.

outputs.name: agent_payoff
outputs.meaning: Agent payoff after quadratic effort cost.

outputs.name: kkt_residual
outputs.meaning: Maximum nonnegativity and stationarity condition residual.

inputs.name: holder
inputs.meaning: Decision-right holder.

parameters.name: alpha
parameters.meaning: Principal alignment with agent decision, in [0,1].

parameters.name: beta
parameters.meaning: Agent alignment with principal decision, in [0,1].

outputs.name: principal_payoff
outputs.meaning: Principal aggregate payoff net of information cost.

outputs.name: agent_payoff
outputs.meaning: Agent aggregate payoff net of information cost.

outputs.name: best_response_residual
outputs.meaning: Maximum residual against the original clipped best responses.

inputs.name: payoffs
inputs.meaning: States by freely traded assets; at least one column is strictly positive in every possible state.

inputs.name: prices
inputs.meaning: Asset prices admitting strictly positive state prices.

inputs.name: claim
inputs.meaning: New claim payoff in the same states.

outputs.name: price_set
outputs.meaning: singleton for a replicated claim; open_interval for an unspanned claim.

outputs.name: positive_state_prices
outputs.unit: currency today per state payoff unit
outputs.meaning: Strictly positive witness for the existing asset prices.

outputs.name: subhedge
outputs.meaning: Portfolio with state payoffs below the claim and price equal to the lower bound.

outputs.name: superhedge
outputs.meaning: Portfolio with state payoffs above the claim and price equal to the upper bound.

outputs.name: replicating_portfolio
outputs.meaning: Exact spanning portfolio at the numerical tolerance, or null for an unspanned claim.

outputs.name: pricing_residual
outputs.meaning: Maximum original asset pricing equation residual.
